node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 diagonal c2 (1,1,2) source-line internal-star reconstruction
node.closure: injective two-fiber reconstruction reducing every classified source-line packet to at most eight source-deck candidate pairs
node.statement: For every saturated source-line diagonal (1,1,2) packet, evaluation at the internal common-K label is injective on the forced-square reciprocal U space. It is a 3-by-3 isomorphism in the positive sign and a two-plane embedding in the negative sign. The pinned odd part and a compatible internal pure-edge pair determine the target U value, so each sign yields at most one source form modulo deck conjugation. Each classified pure multiset has at most four internal assignments, hence at most eight source-deck candidate pairs and no continuous coefficient family.
